SELECT id, account_name AS accountName, account_number AS accountNumber, start_amount AS startAmount, account_status AS accountStatus, is_default AS isDefault, sort_value AS sortValue, remake FROM s_settlement_account WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.accountName}, '%')
AND account_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.accountNumber}, '%')
ORDER BY sort_value ASC, create_time DESC
